baseline: league-constant Poisson from the same CSV (league_poisson_*) and V1 itself
decision_rule: NARROW if mean z^2 > 1 with 95% game-bootstrap CI excluding 1 AND observed P(total>=8) above predicted with 95% Wilson CI excluding the prediction. Symmetrically WIDE. Otherwise CALIBRATED_WIDTH. Reported per statistic, uncorrected, descriptive.
hypothesis: The V1 simulator's predictive distribution is too NARROW: it underestimates 7-9 goal games and over-concentrates totals near 5-6.
method: Regenerate each game's V1 distribution from (lam_home, lam_away, seed) with nhl_edge.sim.engine (4,000 draws, bit-exact vs the CSV). Compare standardized squared residual (y-mu)^2/sigma^2 (expect 1), P(total>=7/8/9), margin tails P(|margin|>=2/3/4), OT and shutout rates, PIT uniformity, RPS (CRPS).
motivation: Operator hypothesis; V1 is independent Poisson with the shared-environment multiplier OFF.

baseline: V1 as published (primary); V2 SIM2_ST published ladder (secondary); constant-home-rate and league Poisson
decision_rule: IMPROVES_EXPLORATORY if paired game-bootstrap 95% CI of delta(RPS total) AND of delta(Brier home win) are each < 0 on EVAL_A; otherwise NO_IMPROVEMENT or MIXED. Any such label is EXPLORATORY until M-LIVE-1 confirms direction and the prospective tier confirms magnitude.
hypothesis: A 3-parameter linear recalibration of V1 expected goals corrects a repeatable error: total-goal rates (s = lam_h+lam_a) are too dispersed across games (slope < 1) while margin rates (d = lam_h-lam_a) are too compressed (slope > 1).
method: C1 SCALE: s' = sbar + b_s (s - sbar); d' = c + b_d d; lam_h' = (s'+d')/2, lam_a' = (s'-d')/2 with (sbar, b_s, c, b_d) from expanding-window OLS on strictly prior games (y_total on s; margin on d), b clipped to [0.2, 2.0]; re-simulate with the SAME seed and 4,000 draws (paired Monte Carlo).
motivation: Full-sample descriptive slopes: margin on d = 1.39 (SE 0.13), total on s = 0.37 (SE 0.17), logit(p_home) slope = 1.41 (SE 0.17).

hypothesis: Adding antithetic per-game strength uncertainty (lam_h x exp(sigma z), lam_a x exp(-sigma z)) widens margin tails without inflating totals and improves RPS(margin) beyond C1.
method: C2 = C1 plus sigma fitted by expanding-window method of moments (match Var(margin) of training games to the simulated variance; sigma in [0, 0.5]); same seeds.
motivation: Home/away goal residual correlation is -0.09 and |margin|>=3 games are 4.9 points more frequent than V1 predicts.

decision_rule: INCREMENTAL if c-adjusted Brier beats BOTH (a) and (b) with 95% game-bootstrap CI < 0 in two or more families; otherwise NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE.
hypothesis: After conditioning on the Kalshi T-60 mid, V1 / C1 carry incremental information for moneyline, full-game total and puck-line contracts.
method: Rolling-origin on 2025 (EVAL_B): y ~ offset(logit mid) + c*(logit p_model - logit mid) with c from prior games only, one coefficient per family; compare Brier of (a) raw mid, (b) calibrated mid (a+b logit mid, prior games), (c) mid + c-adjustment. Game-clustered bootstrap.
motivation: Prior audit: V1/V2 not better than the market; test whether a recalibrated model is.

interpretation: The operator hypothesis (distribution too narrow / 7-9 goal games underestimated) is REJECTED: V1 totals are slightly too WIDE (z2 < 1) and the 7-9 goal tails are inside the observed intervals. Real mis-specifications: regulation ties / OT are under-predicted (17.4% vs 22.8%, V2 largely fixes this), |margin|>=3 games are under-predicted (34.7% vs 39.6%) and >=5 over-predicted (empty-net / score-effect shape). Descriptive, uncorrected, EXPLORATORY.

total_z2.note: (y-mu)^2/sigma^2; 1 = right width, <1 = predictive distribution too WIDE

interpretation: Statistically significant in-sample calibration SLOPES (margin 1.39, total 0.37) did not translate into better predictive scores: every paired delta CI spans zero. The slopes describe how a small spread of rates is mapped, not extra information. Rejected; no challenger advances on this basis.
Rolling method selects sigma = 0 (no antithetic strength uncertainty) from the first evaluation date to the last; margin log score is best at sigma = 0. C2 collapses to C1. Simplest model preferred.

The goalie ladder is NOT over-confident. CONFIRMED and PROJECTED are consistent with the stated confidences; PROBABLE is UNDER-confident (observed ~97% vs stated 85%). Goalie-name uncertainty is therefore not a source of over-confident forecasts at the T-60 cut. Descriptive, n <= 183 per status.

decision_rule: A feature is a CANDIDATE class-A pattern if BH-adjusted p < 0.10. A candidate is not an improvement until a rolling challenger beats V1 (see M-CAL-1).
disclosure: Registered AFTER the first execution of the scan (the 17-feature list was written before executing and was not edited afterwards). The result is therefore descriptive.
hypothesis: V1 residuals (regulation goals - V1 expected goals) are systematically related to information V1 already holds: early-season games, back-to-backs, rest, finishing talent, offensive/defensive xG levels, lam_sum, lam_diff, season.
method: 17 pre-listed (feature, target) OLS tests with HC1 SE on 2,624 WF games, standardised features, Benjamini-Hochberg q=0.10 over all 17 (wf_scan.features).
motivation: Operator questions: are we overvaluing recent scoring trends / finishing, mishandling rest and early-season uncertainty, miscalibrated?

interpretation: Three candidate class-A patterns: total residual falls with lam_sum (total rates over-dispersed across games), falls with the sum of finishing factors (finishing persistence over-weighted for totals) and margin residual rises with lam_diff (matchup differences under-weighted). Early-season, back-to-back, rest and home/away-season effects show NO evidence. Magnitudes are ~0.15-0.2 goals per SD of the feature against a per-game SD of 2.3, so the effects are immaterial for pricing (see M-CAL-1: correcting them does not improve scores).

decision_rule: USEFUL if paired Brier delta CI < 0; CALIBRATED_SCRIPT if mean predicted lies inside the Wilson 95% interval; descriptive, n=151.

hypothesis: Kalshi moneylines reprice around goalie confirmations that change the expected starter, and our archive captures confirmations before the market has absorbed them.
method: Confirmation events with source_reported_at_utc (Daily Faceoff); Kalshi home-leg mid as-of t0-1min vs t0+15/30/60/120 min (15-minute board ticks); abs and signed moves, CHANGE vs SAME vs 3-hour-earlier placebo; our capture lag = first_observed - source_reported.
motivation: Information timing is the only plausible source of a pregame edge; the prior audit declared it untestable for lack of source timestamps.
